newsitem.title: FRANCE: French court to rule on Le Pen "mad fat zebu" jibe.
newsitem.headline: French court to rule on Le Pen "mad fat zebu" jibe.

text.p: A French public prosecutor urged a Paris court on Friday to condemn far-right National Front leader Jean-Marie Le Pen for calling the head of an anti-racism group a "mad fat zebu".

Prosecutor Vincent Lesclous said Le Pen had made a racist slur with the jibe last year against SOS-Racism head Fode Sylla, a burly Frenchman of Senegalese origins. A zebu is a humped domestic ox found in Africa, India and China.
Le Pen's lawyer argued that the remark was not racially charged and urged the court to acquit him.
"The word 'zebu' is not an insult but the name of an animal," said Georges-Paul Wagner. Since zebus are "not essentially African", he argued, Le Pen was not targeting Sylla's racial origins.

Lesclous did not request the court to pass a specific sentence on Le Pen, who wants to send home three million immigrants. Sylla is seeking 100,000 francs ($17,000) in damages and another 100,000 francs for his organisation.

The court will hand down its judgement on July 4. Le Pen called Sylla a zebu after Sylla said Le Pen bore part of the responsibility for the 1990 desecration of a Jewish cemetery by Neo-Nazi skinheads.

In a separate case, Le Pen was questioned by police twice on Thursday in connection with a brawl a week ago during campaigning for France's parliamentary election. The Front won one seat in the National Assembly vote on Sunday.
The 68-year-old Le Pen tussled with a female Socialist election candidate who ended up on the ground during a brawl with anti-Front protesters.
